review_evidence: README identifies formal definitions of special soundness, honest-verifier zero knowledge, completeness, composition theorems, and machine-checked results for generalized Bulletproofs and folding protocols.

Sigma.lean documents and imports a theorem-bearing framework of reductions, reduction trees, composition, IPA/GBP protocol variants, extraction machinery, Vandermonde/linear-algebra utilities, and soundness/completeness/HVZK theorems across 57 primary Lean files.

The root umbrella is navigation-relevant and the remaining modules are formal definitions/proofs or supporting constructions. No content-level invariant establishes a lossless hard exclusion for any primary file.
